title: ACC-Orlando Hybrid PALT Update Session 14 April 2026
agency_path: DEPT OF DEFENSE.DEPT OF THE ARMY.AMC.ACC.ACC-CTRS.ACC-ORLANDO.W6QK ACC-ORLANDO
detail_text: US Army Contracting Command-Orlando will host a Hybrid PALT Update Session on Tuesday, 14 April 2026 from 1100-1200 ET at the Tech Grove Facility, located on the ground floor of the Partnership IV facility, 12809 Science Drive, Orlando, FL. The session will include ACC-Orlando, CPE ST3, and PM TRASYS (U.S. Marine Corps) representatives. This hybrid session can accommodate a maximum of 160 industry partners for in-person attendance, and up to 300 virtually via MS Teams. To attend this Hybrid PALT Update Session, individuals must register/RSVP for the in-person or virtual session. The deadline to submit questions is Friday, 3 April 2026; 11:59 PM ET. The deadline to register is Thursday, 9 April 2026; 11:59 PM ET; Questions submitted after 3 April 2026 may not be answered during PALT. Links to register/RSVP: https://forms.osi.apps.mil/r/sF4PQ4ysEA Note: Instructions for joining the session will be provided via email a few days prior to the actual session date. Note: In-person registration will close once we reach the 160 person limit. Once the limit is reached, individuals will need to RSVP using the link above for Virtual participation to attend via MS TEAMS. IMPORTANT NOTES REGARDING IN-PERSON ATTENDANCE: Individuals who register for in-person attendance must present a photo ID to gain entrance to the Tech Grove facility. Due to limited parking at the Partnership IV/Tech Grove facility, We strongly advise that attendees DO NOT PARK in the reserved spots. In-person attendees are encouraged to park in the open lot on the southeast corner of Science Drive and Technology Parkway, adjacent to the entrance to NAWCTSD and proceed on foot to the Partnership IV/Tech Grove facility. ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ When registering, you will have the option of submitting question(s). If you elect to submit an question, we ask that you pose a specific and complete question, DO NOT only a program acronym or name. A complete question will assist the respective Government point of contact in providing focused and accurate answers during the session. We will first address the questions we receive in advance, and if there is time remaining, open the floor for questions. to ensure we target the most relevant contract-related questions, we recommend you submit them in advance. Information provided by the Government during this hybrid PALT Update Session will be limited to status updates pertaining to specific procurements. The Government will not provide any procurement sensitive information that would violate the integrity of the source selection process. We will continue to post updated versions of our ACC-Orlando Workload Point of Contact chart and Customer Contracting Common Operating Picture (C3OP) to our ACC-Orlando public website monthly. As always, if you have any questions regarding specific programs of interest after the hybrid PALT Update Session, you may contact the applicable Contracting Officer directly. The slides presented at the 17 February 2026 PALT Update session are attached to this announcement for reference.
